In addition, nonmagical armor worn by the target is partly dissolved and takes a permanent and cumulative −1 penalty to the AC it offers. The armor is destroyed if the penalty reduces its AC to 10.

creature_builder_entries.name: Read Thoughts (Doppelganger)
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> magically reads the surface thoughts of one creature within 60 feet of it. The effect can penetrate barriers, but 3 feet of wood or dirt, 2 feet of stone, 2 inches of metal, or a thin sheet of lead blocks it. While the target is in range, <$short_name$> can continue reading its thoughts, as long as <$short_name$>'s concentration isn't broken (as if concentrating on a spell). While reading the target's mind, <$short_name$> has advantage on Wisdom (Insight) and Charisma (Deception, Intimidation, and Persuasion) checks against the target.

creature_builder_entries.name: Reaping Scythe
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> sweeps its spectral scythe through a creature within 5 feet of it, dealing <$damage_avg__4+str$> (1d8<$damage_mod__str$>) slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) necrotic damage.

creature_builder_entries.name: Reel (Roper)

If the curse reduces the target's hit point maximum to 0, the target dies, and its body turns to dust. The curse lasts until removed by the remove curse spell or other magic.

creature_builder_entries.name: Scare (Quasit)

If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC <$dc__con$> saving throw or have its hit point maximum reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. The target dies if this attack reduces its hit point maximum to 0. The reduction lasts until removed by the greater restoration spell or other magic.

In addition, the target can take either an action or a bonus action on its turn, not both. These effects last for 1 minute. creature_builder_entries.name: Steam Breath (Dragon Turtle)
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> exhales scalding steam in a 60-foot cone. creature_builder_entries.name: Stunning Screech (Vrock)
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> emits a horrific screech. Each creature within 20 feet of it that can hear it and that isn't a demon must succeed on a DC <$dc__con$> Constitution Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of <$short_name$>'s next turn.

creature_builder_entries.name: Swallow (Behir)
creature_builder_entries.description:
<$title_short_name$> makes one bite attack against a Medium or smaller target it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is also swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the target is blinded and restrained, it has 3 against attacks and other effects outside <$short_name$>, and it takes 21 (6d6) acid damage at the start of each of <$short_name$>'s turns. A <$short_name$> can have only one creature swallowed at a time.

If <$short_name$> takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, <$short_name$> must succeed on a DC <$dc__con$> Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls prone in a space within 10 feet of <$short_name$>. If <$short_name$> dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using 15 feet of movement, exiting prone.

Unless the target is surprised or the revelation of <$short_name$>'s true form is sudden, the target can avert its eyes and avoid making the initial saving throw. Until the start of its next turn, a creature that averts its eyes has disadvantage on attack rolls against <$short_name$>.

creature_builder_entries.name: Ice Walk
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, 3 composed of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra movement.

creature_builder_entries.name: Ignited Illumination (Magmin)
creature_builder_entries.description: As a bonus action, <$short_name$> can set itself ablaze or extinguish its flames. While ablaze, <$short_name$> sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet.

creature_builder_entries.name: Illumination (Azer)
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet.

creature_builder_entries.name: Illumination (Fire Elemental)
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet.

creature_builder_entries.name: Illumination (Giant Fire Beetle)
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet.

creature_builder_entries.name: Illumination (Nightmare)
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet.

creature_builder_entries.name: Immutable Form
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

creature_builder_entries.name: Incorporeal Movement
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> can move through other creatures and objects as if they were 3. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

creature_builder_entries.name: Inscrutable
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> is immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, as well as any divination spell that it refuses. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain <$short_name$>'s intentions or sincerity have disadvantage.

creature_builder_entries.name: Invisibility
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> is invisible.

creature_builder_entries.name: Iron Scent
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> can pinpoint, by scent, the location of ferrous metal within 30 feet of it.

creature_builder_entries.name: Keen Hearing
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing.

creature_builder_entries.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

creature_builder_entries.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

creature_builder_entries.name: Keen Senses
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight, hearing or smell.

creature_builder_entries.name: Keen Sight
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

creature_builder_entries.name: Keen Sight and Smell
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight or smell.

creature_builder_entries.name: Keen Smell
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

creature_builder_entries.name: Labyrinthine Recall
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> can perfectly recall any path it has traveled.

creature_builder_entries.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
creature_builder_entries.description: If <$short_name$> fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

creature_builder_entries.name: Light Sensitivity
creature_builder_entries.description: While in bright light, <$short_name$> has disadvantage on attack rolls and Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

creature_builder_entries.name: Lightning Absorption
creature_builder_entries.description: Whenever <$short_name$> is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the lightning damage dealt.

creature_builder_entries.name: Limited Amphibiousness (Sahuagin)
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> can breathe air and water, but it needs to be submerged at least once every 4 hours to avoid suffocating.

creature_builder_entries.name: Limited Magic Immunity (Rakshasa)
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> can't be affected or detected by spells of 6th level or lower unless it wishes to be. It has advantage on saving throws against all other spells and magical effects.

creature_builder_entries.name: Limited Telepathy (Otyugh)
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> can magically transmit simple messages and images to any creature within 120 feet of it that can understand a language. This form of telepathy doesn't allow the receiving creature to telepathically respond.

creature_builder_entries.name: Limited Telepathy (Pseudodragon)
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> can magically communicate simple ideas, emotions, and images telepathically with any creature within 100 feet of it that can understand a language.

creature_builder_entries.name: Magic Resistance
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

creature_builder_entries.name: Magic Weapons
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$>'s weapon attacks are magical.

creature_builder_entries.name: Martial Advantage (Hobgoblin)
creature_builder_entries.description: Once per turn, <$short_name$> can deal an extra 7 (2d6) damage to a creature it hits with a weapon attack if that creature is within 5 feet of an ally of <$short_name$> that isn't incapacitated.

creature_builder_entries.name: Mimicry (Green Hag)
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> can mimic animal sounds and humanoid voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 14 Wisdom (Insight) check.

creature_builder_entries.name: Mimicry (Raven)
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> can mimic simple sounds it has heard, such as a person whispering, a baby crying, or an animal chittering. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 10 Wisdom (Insight) check.

creature_builder_entries.name: Misty Escape (Vampire)
creature_builder_entries.description:
When it drops to 0 hit points outside its resting place, <$short_name$> transforms into a cloud of mist (as in the Shapechanger trait) instead of falling unconscious, provided that it isn't in sunlight or running water. If it can't transform, it is destroyed.

While it has 0 hit points in mist form, it can't revert to its <$short_name$> form, and it must reach its resting place within 2 hours or be destroyed. Once in its resting place, it reverts to its <$short_name$> form. It is then paralyzed until it regains at least 1 hit point. After spending 1 hour in its resting place with 0 hit points, it regains 1 hit point.

creature_builder_entries.name: Mucous Cloud (Aboleth)
creature_builder_entries.description: While underwater, <$short_name$> is surrounded by transformative mucus. A creature that touches <$short_name$> or that hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it must make a DC 14 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature is diseased for 1d4 hours. The diseased creature can breathe only underwater.

creature_builder_entries.name: Multiple Heads (Hydra)
creature_builder_entries.description:
<$title_short_name$> has five heads. While it has more than one head, <$short_name$> has advantage on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious.

Whenever <$short_name$> takes 25 or more damage in a single turn, one of its heads dies. If all its heads die, <$short_name$> dies.

At the end of its turn, it grows two heads for each of its heads that died since its last turn, unless it has taken fire damage since its last turn. <$title_short_name$> regains 10 hit points for each head regrown in this way.

creature_builder_entries.name: Nimble Escape
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of its turns.

creature_builder_entries.name: Ooze Cube (Gelatinous Cube)
creature_builder_entries.description:
<$title_short_name$> takes up its entire space. Other creatures can enter the space, but a creature that does so is subjected to <$short_name$>'s Engulf and has disadvantage on the saving throw.

Creatures inside <$short_name$> can be seen but have 3.

A creature within 5 feet of <$short_name$> can take an action to pull a creature or object out of <$short_name$>. Doing so requires a successful DC 12 Strength check, and the creature making the attempt takes 10 (3d6) acid damage.

<$title_short_name$> can hold only one Large creature or up to four Medium or smaller creatures inside it at a time.

creature_builder_entries.name: Otherworldly Perception
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> can sense the presence of any creature within 30 feet of it that is invisible or on the Ethereal Plane. It can pinpoint such a creature that is moving.

creature_builder_entries.name: Pack Tactics
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of <$short_name$>'s allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

creature_builder_entries.name: Petrifying Gaze (Basilisk)
creature_builder_entries.description:
If a creature starts its turn within 30 feet of <$short_name$> and the two of them can see each other, <$short_name$> can force the creature to make a DC 12 Constitution saving throw if <$short_name$> isn't incapacitated. On a failed save, the creature magically begins to turn to stone and is restrained. It must repeat the saving throw at the end of its next turn. On a success, the effect ends. On a failure, the creature is petrified until freed by the greater restoration spell or other magic.

A creature that isn't surprised can avert its eyes to avoid the saving throw at the start of its turn. If it does so, it can't see <$short_name$> until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If it looks at <$short_name$> in the meantime, it must immediately make the save.

If <$short_name$> sees its reflection within 30 feet of it in bright light, it mistakes itself for a rival and targets itself with its gaze.

creature_builder_entries.name: Pounce (Lion)
creature_builder_entries.description: If <$short_name$> moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, <$short_name$> can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

creature_builder_entries.name: Pounce (Panther)
creature_builder_entries.description: If <$short_name$> moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, <$short_name$> can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

creature_builder_entries.name: Pounce (Saber-Toothed Tiger)
creature_builder_entries.description: If <$short_name$> moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, <$short_name$> can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

creature_builder_entries.name: Pounce (Tiger)
creature_builder_entries.description: If <$short_name$> moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, <$short_name$> can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

creature_builder_entries.name: Pounce (Weretiger)
creature_builder_entries.description: If <$short_name$> moves at least 15 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a claw attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, <$short_name$> can make one bite attack against it as a bonus action.

creature_builder_entries.name: Probing Telepathy (Aboleth)
creature_builder_entries.description: If a creature communicates telepathically with <$short_name$>, <$short_name$> learns the creature's greatest desires if <$short_name$> can see the creature.

creature_builder_entries.name: Psychic Defense
creature_builder_entries.description: While <$short_name$> is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, its AC includes its Wisdom modifier.

creature_builder_entries.name: Rampage
creature_builder_entries.description: When <$short_name$> reduces a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack on its turn, <$short_name$> can take a bonus action to move up to half its speed and make another attack.

creature_builder_entries.name: Reactive
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> can take one reaction on every turn in combat.

creature_builder_entries.name: Reactive Heads (Hydra)
creature_builder_entries.description: For each head <$short_name$> has beyond one, it gets an extra reaction that can be used only for opportunity attacks.

creature_builder_entries.name: Reckless
creature_builder_entries.description: At the start of its turn, <$short_name$> can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls it makes during that turn, but attack rolls against it have advantage until the start of its next turn.

creature_builder_entries.name: Reflective Carapace (Tarrasque)
creature_builder_entries.description: Any time <$short_name$> is targeted by a magic missile spell, a line spell, or a spell that requires a ranged attack roll, roll a d6. On a 1 to 5, <$short_name$> is unaffected. On a 6, <$short_name$> is unaffected, and the effect is reflected back at the caster as though it originated from <$short_name$>, turning the caster into the target.

creature_builder_entries.name: Regeneration (Oni)
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point.

creature_builder_entries.name: Regeneration (Shield Guardian)
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point.

creature_builder_entries.name: Regeneration (Troll)
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If <$short_name$> takes acid or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of <$short_name$>'s next turn. <$title_short_name$> dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

creature_builder_entries.name: Regeneration (Vampire Spawn)
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If <$short_name$> takes radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of <$short_name$>'s next turn.

creature_builder_entries.name: Regeneration (Vampire)
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> regains 20 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If <$short_name$> takes radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of <$short_name$>'s next turn.

creature_builder_entries.name: Rejuvenation (Guardian Naga)
creature_builder_entries.description: If it dies, <$short_name$> returns to life in 1d6 days and regains all its hit points. Only a wish spell can prevent this trait from functioning.

creature_builder_entries.name: Rejuvenation (Lich)
creature_builder_entries.description: If it has a phylactery, a destroyed <$short_name$> gains a new body in 1d10 days, regaining all its hit points and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of the phylactery.

creature_builder_entries.name: Rejuvenation (Mummy Lord)
creature_builder_entries.description: A destroyed <$short_name$> gains a new body in 24 hours if its heart is intact, regaining all its hit points and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of <$short_name$>'s heart.

creature_builder_entries.name: Rejuvenation (Spirit Naga)
creature_builder_entries.description: If it dies, <$short_name$> returns to life in 1d6 days and regains all its hit points. Only a wish spell can prevent this trait from functioning.

creature_builder_entries.name: Relentless (Boar)
creature_builder_entries.description: If <$short_name$> takes 7 damage or less that would reduce it to 0 hit points, it is reduced to 1 hit point instead.

creature_builder_entries.name: Relentless (Giant Boar)
creature_builder_entries.description: If <$short_name$> takes 10 damage or less that would reduce it to 0 hit points, it is reduced to 1 hit point instead.

creature_builder_entries.name: Relentless (Wereboar)
creature_builder_entries.description: If <$short_name$> takes 14 damage or less that would reduce it to 0 hit points, it is reduced to 1 hit point instead.

creature_builder_entries.name: Running Leap (Lion)
creature_builder_entries.description: With a 10-foot running start, <$short_name$> can long jump up to 25 feet.

creature_builder_entries.name: Rust Metal
creature_builder_entries.description: Any nonmagical weapon made of metal that hits <$short_name$> corrodes. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative −1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to −5, the weapon is destroyed. Nonmagical ammunition made of metal that hits <$short_name$> is destroyed after dealing damage.

creature_builder_entries.name: Sense Magic (Chuul)
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> senses magic within 120 feet of it at will. This trait otherwise works like the detect magic spell but isn't itself magical

creature_builder_entries.name: Shadow Stealth
creature_builder_entries.description: While in dim light or darkness, <$short_name$> can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

creature_builder_entries.name: Shapechanger (Doppelganger)
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> can use its action to polymorph into a Small or Medium humanoid it has seen, or back into its true form. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

creature_builder_entries.name: Shapechanger (Imp)
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> can use its action to polymorph into a beast form that resembles a rat (speed 20 ft.), a raven (20 ft., fly 60 ft.), or a spider (20 ft., climb 20 ft.), or back into its true form. Its statistics are the same in each form, except for the speed changes noted. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

creature_builder_entries.name: Shapechanger (Mimic)
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> can use its action to polymorph into an object or back into its true, amorphous form. Its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

creature_builder_entries.name: Shapechanger (Quasit)
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> can use its action to polymorph into a beast form that resembles a bat (speed 10 ft. fly 40 ft.), a centipede (40 ft., climb 40 ft.), or a toad (40 ft., swim 40 ft.), or back into its true form. Its statistics are the same in each form, except for the speed changes noted. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

creature_builder_entries.name: Shapechanger (Succubus/Incubus)
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> can use its action to polymorph into a Small or Medium humanoid, or back into its true form. Without wings, <$short_name$> loses its flying speed. Other than its size and speed, its statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

creature_builder_entries.name: Shapechanger (Vampire)
creature_builder_entries.description: If <$short_name$> isn't in sunlight or running water, it can use its action to polymorph into a Tiny bat or a Medium cloud of mist, or back into its true form. While in bat form, <$short_name$> can't speak, its walking speed is 5 feet, and it has a flying speed of 30 feet. Its statistics, other than its size and speed, are unchanged. Anything it is wearing transforms with it, but nothing it is carrying does. It reverts to its true form if it dies. While in mist form, <$short_name$> can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects. It is weightless, has a flying speed of 20 feet, can hover, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. In addition, if air can pass through a space, the mist can do so without squeezing, and it can't pass through water. It has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws, and it is immune to all nonmagical damage, except the damage it takes from sunlight.

creature_builder_entries.name: Shapechanger (Werebear)
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> can use its action to polymorph into a Large bear-humanoid hybrid or into a Large bear, or back into its true form, which is humanoid. Its statistics, other than its size and AC, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

creature_builder_entries.name: Shapechanger (Wereboar)
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> can use its action to polymorph into a boar-humanoid hybrid or into a boar, or back into its true form, which is humanoid. Its statistics, other than its AC, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

creature_builder_entries.name: Shapechanger (Wererat)
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> can use its action to polymorph into a rat-humanoid hybrid or into a giant rat, or back into its true form, which is humanoid. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

creature_builder_entries.name: Shapechanger (Weretiger)
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> can use its action to polymorph into a tiger-humanoid hybrid or into a tiger, or back into its true form, which is humanoid. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

creature_builder_entries.name: Shapechanger (Werewolf)
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> can use its action to polymorph into a wolf-humanoid hybrid or into a wolf, or back into its true form, which is humanoid. Its statistics, other than its AC, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

creature_builder_entries.name: Shark Telepathy
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> can magically command any shark within 120 feet of it, using a limited telepathy.

creature_builder_entries.name: Shielded Mind
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> is immune to scrying and to any effect that would sense its emotions, read its thoughts, or detect its location.

creature_builder_entries.name: Siege Monster
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> deals double damage to objects and structures.

creature_builder_entries.name: Slippery
creature_builder_entries.description: The kuo-toa has advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to escape a grapple.

creature_builder_entries.name: Sneak Attack (Assassin)
creature_builder_entries.description: Once per turn, <$short_name$> deals an extra 14 (4d6) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of <$short_name$> that isn't incapacitated and <$short_name$> doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

creature_builder_entries.name: Sneak Attack (Spy)
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> deals an extra 7 (2d6) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of <$short_name$> that isn't incapacitated and <$short_name$> doesn't have disadvantage on the attack roll.

creature_builder_entries.name: Snow Camouflage
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in snowy terrain.

creature_builder_entries.name: Speak with Beasts and Plants
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> can communicate with beasts and plants as if they shared a language.

creature_builder_entries.name: Spell Storing (Shield Guardian)
creature_builder_entries.description: A spellcaster who wears <$short_name$>'s amulet can cause <$short_name$> to store one spell of 4th level or lower. To do so, the wearer must cast the spell on <$short_name$>. The spell has no effect but is stored within <$short_name$>. When commanded to do so by the wearer or when a situation arises that was predefined by the spellcaster, <$short_name$> casts the stored spell with any parameters set by the original caster, requiring no components. When the spell is cast or a new spell is stored, any previously stored spell is lost.

creature_builder_entries.name: Spider Climb
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

creature_builder_entries.name: Standing Leap (Bulette)
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$>'s long jump is up to 30 feet and its high jump is up to 15 feet, with or without a running start.

creature_builder_entries.name: Standing Leap (Frog)
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$>'s long jump is up to 10 feet and its high jump is up to 5 feet, with or without a running start.

creature_builder_entries.name: Standing Leap (Giant Frog)
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$>'s long jump is up to 20 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

creature_builder_entries.name: Standing Leap (Giant Toad)
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$>'s long jump is up to 20 feet and its high jump is up to 10 feet, with or without a running start.

creature_builder_entries.name: Steadfast
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> can't be frightened while it can see an allied creature within 30 feet of it.

creature_builder_entries.name: Stench (Hezrou)
creature_builder_entries.description: Any creature that starts its turn within 10 feet of <$short_name$> must succeed on a DC 14 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned until the start of its next turn. On a successful saving throw, the creature is immune to <$short_name$>'s stench for 24 hours.

creature_builder_entries.name: Stone Camouflage
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in rocky terrain.

creature_builder_entries.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
creature_builder_entries.description: While in sunlight, <$short_name$> has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

creature_builder_entries.name: Sunlight Weakness
creature_builder_entries.description: While in sunlight, <$short_name$> has disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.

creature_builder_entries.name: Sure-Footed
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> has advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws made against effects that would knock it prone.

creature_builder_entries.name: Surprise Attack (Bugbear)
creature_builder_entries.description: If <$short_name$> surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 7 (2d6) damage from the attack.

creature_builder_entries.name: Surprise Attack (Doppelganger)
creature_builder_entries.description: If <$short_name$> surprises a creature and hits it with an attack during the first round of combat, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) damage from the attack.

creature_builder_entries.name: Swamp Camouflage
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide in swampy terrain.

creature_builder_entries.name: Swarm (Swarm of Bats)
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny bat. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

creature_builder_entries.name: Swarm (Swarm of Insects)
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny insect. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

creature_builder_entries.name: Swarm (Swarm of Poisonous Snakes)
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny snake. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

creature_builder_entries.name: Swarm (Swarm of Quippers)
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny quipper. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

creature_builder_entries.name: Swarm (Swarm of Rats)
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny rat. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

creature_builder_entries.name: Swarm (Swarm of Ravens)
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny raven. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

creature_builder_entries.name: Tactical Discipline
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> has advantage on all ability checks and saving throws made during combat.

creature_builder_entries.name: Tail Spike Regrowth (Manticore)
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> has twenty-four tail spikes. Used spikes regrow when <$short_name$> finishes a long rest.

creature_builder_entries.name: Telepathic Bond (Homunculus)
creature_builder_entries.description: While <$short_name$> is on the same plane of existence as its master, it can magically convey what it senses to its master, and the two can communicate telepathically.

creature_builder_entries.name: Telepathic Bond (Succubus/Incubus)
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> ignores the range restriction on its telepathy when communicating with a creature it has charmed. The two don't even need to be on the same plane of existence.

creature_builder_entries.name: Trampling Charge (Elephant)
creature_builder_entries.description: If <$short_name$> moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 12 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, <$short_name$> can make one stomp attack against it as a bonus action.

creature_builder_entries.name: Trampling Charge (Gorgon)
creature_builder_entries.description: If <$short_name$> moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 16 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, <$short_name$> can make one attack with its hooves against it as a bonus action.

creature_builder_entries.name: Trampling Charge (Mammoth)
creature_builder_entries.description: If <$short_name$> moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 18 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, <$short_name$> can make one stomp attack against it as a bonus action.

creature_builder_entries.name: Trampling Charge (Triceratops)
creature_builder_entries.description: If <$short_name$> moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a gore attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, <$short_name$> can make one stomp attack against it as a bonus action.

creature_builder_entries.name: Trampling Charge (Warhorse)
creature_builder_entries.description: If <$short_name$> moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a hooves attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a DC 14 Strength saving throw or be knocked prone. If the target is prone, <$short_name$> can make another attack with its hooves against it as a bonus action.

creature_builder_entries.name: Transparent (Gelatinous Cube)
creature_builder_entries.description: Even when <$short_name$> is in plain sight, it takes a successful DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check to spot a <$short_name$> that has neither moved nor attacked. A creature that tries to enter <$short_name$>'s space while unaware of <$short_name$> is surprised by <$short_name$>.

creature_builder_entries.name: Treasure Sense
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> can pinpoint, by scent, the location of precious metals and stones, such as coins and gems, within 60 feet of it.

creature_builder_entries.name: Tree Stride
creature_builder_entries.description: Once on their turn, <$short_name$> can use 10 feet of movement to step magically into one living tree within reach and emerge from a second living tree within 60 feet of the first tree, appearing in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the second tree. Both trees must be Large or bigger.

creature_builder_entries.name: Tunneler (Purple Worm)
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> can burrow through solid rock at half its burrow speed and leaves a 10-foot-diameter tunnel in its wake.

creature_builder_entries.name: Turn Immunity
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> is immune to effects that turn undead.

creature_builder_entries.name: Turn Resistance
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

creature_builder_entries.name: Turning Defiance (Ghast)
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> and any ghouls within 30 feet of it have advantage on saving throws against effects that turn undead.

creature_builder_entries.name: Two Heads
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks and on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, or knocked unconscious.

creature_builder_entries.name: Undead Fortitude
creature_builder_entries.description: If damage reduces <$short_name$> to 0 hit points, it must make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, <$short_name$> drops to 1 hit point instead.

creature_builder_entries.name: Underwater Camouflage
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made while underwater.

creature_builder_entries.name: Vampire Weakness (Vampire)
creature_builder_entries.description:
<$title_short_name$> has the following flaws:

Forbiddance. <$title_short_name$> can't enter a residence without an invitation from one of the occupants.

Harmed by Running Water. <$title_short_name$> takes 20 acid damage if it ends its turn in running water.

Stake to the Heart. If a piercing weapon made of wood is driven into <$short_name$>'s heart while <$short_name$> is incapacitated in its resting place, <$short_name$> is paralyzed until the stake is removed.

Sunlight Hypersensitivity. <$title_short_name$> takes 20 radiant damage when it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

creature_builder_entries.name: Variable Illumination (Will-o'-Wisp)
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> sheds bright light in a 5- to 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional number of feet equal to the chosen radius. <$title_short_name$> can alter the radius as a bonus action.

creature_builder_entries.name: Wakeful (Ettin)
creature_builder_entries.description: When one of <$short_name$>'s heads is asleep, another head is awake.

creature_builder_entries.name: Wakeful (Hydra)
creature_builder_entries.description: While <$short_name$> sleeps, at least one of its heads is awake.

creature_builder_entries.name: Water Breathing
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> can breathe only underwater.

creature_builder_entries.name: Water Form (Water Elemental)
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

creature_builder_entries.name: Water Susceptibility (Fire Elemental)
creature_builder_entries.description: For every 5 feet <$short_name$> moves in water, or for every gallon of water splashed on it, it takes 1 cold damage.

creature_builder_entries.name: Web Sense
creature_builder_entries.description: While in contact with a web, <$short_name$> knows the exact location of any other creature in contact with the same web.

creature_builder_entries.name: Web Walker
creature_builder_entries.description: <$title_short_name$> ignores movement restrictions caused by webbing.
